title: 1950'S SHELLEY TEA SET 'HEATHE...
reason: Complete-looking 22-piece Shelley Heather 13419 tea set with a clear backstamp in a popular collectable pattern.
findings: Shelley bone china tea set in the Heather pattern (autumn trees and heather landscape, pale green handles and cake plate handles, gilt rims). Backstamp read in photo 2: green printed 'Fine Bone China / Shelley / England' logo with 'Heather' and the pattern number 13419 in pink (first digit faint). Pieces seen: 6 trios (cup, saucer, side plate), 1 spare saucer or plate, a square handled cake plate, milk jug and sugar bowl, about 22 pieces. Marks support the title (mid 20th century Shelley, Heather). Price check: a dealer listing for a 21-piece Heather 13419 set was seen at GBP 108 (ebay.de item 236251773161, search results 19/10/2026), a single cup and saucer was listed at US$22 (ebay.de item 127526841684).
condition: Gilt rims, enamel and handles look bright and intact; no chips, cracks or crazing visible. Only a few pieces are shown close up; inside of cups and undersides of most pieces not checked.
rescore_note: Genuine 1950s Shelley Heather 13419 (backstamp read), 6 trios plus cake plate, milk and sugar, bright and apparently perfect; a UK dealer asked GBP 108 for a 21-piece set (ebay.de item 236251773161, seen 19/10/2026), so my estimate is $150 to $250.
